Graph of rate of reaction against pH, with points R and S labelled.

stem.text: Which statement is a correct explanation of the enzyme activity?

A.text: At P, hydrogen bonds are formed between enzyme and substrate.

B.text: At Q, the kinetic energy of enzyme and substrate is highest.

C.text: At R, disulfide bonds in the enzyme begin to break.

D.text: At S, the enzyme is completely denatured.
